title: Putty connection - option "-batch" not available in this tool
author: Alessio71
body_snippet: mRemoteNG 1.82.0-beta.1 NB Build 3424 when launching a SSH V2 connection I get this error what could it be and how do I fix it? Thanks

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hi @Alessio71, thanks for the report!

The `-batch` flag is used to prevent PuTTY from showing interactive password retry prompts. However, not all PuTTY variants support this option.

Could you help us narrow this down?
1. Are you using the **bundled PuTTYNG.exe** that ships with mRemoteNG, or do you have a **custom PuTTY/KiTTY** configured in Tools → Options → Advanced?
2. If using a custom tool, what is the name and version?
3. Does the SSH connection work if you manually remove `-batch` from...

comments.author: Alessio71
comments.snippet: Hi @robertpopa22, I've selected the official Putty executable 0.83 I'm sorry but I don't know how to remove `-batch` from the arguments. I thought that using the latest version of Putty was the best option, now I tried to unselect the custom PuTTY option but the error still appears (I've checked, now it uses your PuTTYNG.exe but with the same results)

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the additional details @Alessio71!

This is puzzling — PuTTY 0.83 (official) **definitely** supports `-batch` (it's been available since version 0.62). And our bundled PuTTYNG.exe is also built from PuTTY 0.83 source, so it supports it too. I've just verified locally — both accept `-batch` without errors.

This means the error might not actually be about `-batch`. Could you help us confirm:
